title: base-6.1 vs base-7.x
verdict_rule: better means the new pack called the target API and the previous pack did not. worse means the previous pack called the target API and the new pack did not. Rows from a different verb do not count. On Find hoppy citrus beers the target is search hybrid. That row is worse when the previous pack calls search hybrid and the new pack calls search fts, find, or set, even when both sides are HTTP 200 and both returned beers. same means both called the target, or neither did. not run means a model call is missing. When the question says rows are required, an empty Zeus result is not met.

rows.text: What beers come from Belgian breweries?
rows.notes: The forward body from Beer with where {} , path [brewery_id, country], where country=belgium is HTTP 400 on 0.9.19: an empty where is not a selector. Rows included Oude Geuze, Drie Fonteinen Kriek, and Leffe Blonde. Country where name=Belgium inverse to Brewery returned 0 rows.
